Plunge, LLC Privacy Policy:

Plunge Digital Privacy Policy

Effective Date: Effective Date: August 1, 2021

Last Updated: July 2, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how Plunge, LLC (d/b/a Plunge Digital) and its affiliates (“Plunge”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) collect, use, disclose, and protect personal information in connection with our business as a data broker and provider of data services. This policy applies to information collected through our websites, online services, offline sources, partnerships, and third-party data suppliers.
